messages:
kevin: quick check — helmfile applied to tenant-namespace but SA not annotated for IRSA, pods failing s3 access. Anyone seen this pattern?

mira: did helmfile include serviceAccount.create: true? often overrides per-chart set sa.name and annotations.

kevin: we created SA separately via terraform to centralize policies. helm attempted to create another SA, so annotation missing.

sam: ok — if TF owns SA we should add annotation in tf aws_iam_role_association or use kubernetes_service_account metadata.annotations = { "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.foo.arn }

kevin: thanks — TF change is painless. quick question: do I need to restart pods? currently pods have old token and no creds.

lucy: yes pod restart needed to pick up projected token change. either `kubectl -n tenant rollout restart deployment/<name>` or patch the SA and restart. rollout is easiest.

mira: snippet: `kubectl -n tenant rollout restart deployment/my-uploader`

kevin: done, logs show token error cleared. one more: terraform plan shows sa name is templated, how do we reference it in the annotation without race?

sam: reference k8s service account resource name directly in tf, or use depends_on to ensure role exists before binding. tf example:

```
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "uploader" {
  metadata {
    name      = "uploader"
    namespace = var.ns
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.uploader.arn
    }
  }
}
```

mira: also watch for helm lifecycles — set helm values to not create SA: `serviceAccount.create=false` and `serviceAccount.name=uploader`

deploy-bot: CI:infra apply succeeded for tenant-namespace (plan id: plan-7890) :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks all — I'll open a small PR to add annotation in terraform and update helmfile values. pinging @mira for review.

mira: happy to review, please include the tf plan link and helmfile diff. :+1:

sam: if you want I can add a short test job that deploys to a staging ns and validates s3 access.

kevin: that'd be great, thx. closing the loop — issue resolved for now.
